title: Finite witnessed projection comparison through a common refinement
statement: At a positive finite coefficient level, the actual projection maps for two compactifications obey the common-refinement comparison square, for bounded constructible K and finite-Tor L. Both the origin witness O for K and the origin witness OT and isomorphism e presenting K tensor Lf*L are retained. The assertion is precisely finiteLaw D C E n hn hl in the fixed scalar presentation of [def-sf-projection-single-refinement-law].

proof.text: Split n=0 by omega. For n=m+1, unfold finiteLaw and apply the intermediate finiteProjectionFromDescent theorem to the family of refinement-law clauses for the fixed f.
Obtain the required family by taking the refinementLaw conjunct (the second conjunct of the first clause) from ProjectionRefinementDescent.finite_descent for each f.
